claims.title: Covalent packet repair trades wrong-partner access against multivalent clearance and discarded correct links

quoted_fields.interface: Actual registered reactive handles, constant intended/wrong hazards or their explicitly bounded spatial alternative; for reset, independent identical per-edge success, no wrong bonds/damage, complete unrooted-island clearance and retained rooted product in the original register. Multivalent clearance assumes independent arms and an absorbing wash sink. These are model premises, not demonstrated CuAAC reset capabilities.
quoted_fields.failure: This differs from N992's imine checkpoint and does not supersede its reader/reset obstructions. Root connectivity, full mass and end identifiers do not certify sequence: ((m-1)!)^2 alternating orders share those observations for2m distinct monomers with fixed endpoint types/identities. That count does not imply the alternatives occur. Irreversible wrong rooted bonds pass a connectivity filter. The quadratic race law requires all-to-all constant rates; bounded access is a different and favorable interface. Packet isolation, reliable fusion/root removal, preserved recognition adapters and repeated re-registration remain unacquired. Cleaving coding adapters can destroy positional information needed for another retry. Source-cited component chemistry is not independently reverified, and reported simulations are not replayed.

claims.title: Two-sided retained grafts face shared shutdown; catalytic persistence cannot create missing fibre contact

quoted_fields.interface: Actual old/new molecular contact; independent identical arms and declared retained-donor probability; conditional independence given a shared local access clock; Poisson candidate count and fixed positive k,d,eta. Guaranteed T0 requires active retained enzyme, acceptors, water and contact throughout that time. Contact race assumes independent exponential contact/shutdown and growth unable to establish new contact after shutdown.
quoted_fields.failure: Molecular attachment is not necessarily a two-sided retained weld, and cleaving cellulose can harm the original load path. The inclusion-exclusion law does not measure wet strength or fracture energy. Source-cited HTG/AtXTH3/production precedents were not independently primary-read here; neither is an acquired old-new bacterial-cellulose welding operation. Cellulose-I activity conversion, contact/force/shear numbers, optimization tables and quadrature/Monte Carlo checks remain source-reported sensitivity models, not calibrated living interfaces. Balanced staging at fixed total arm success ties the independent-arm maximum; conditional or preanchored mechanisms change that interface. A retained enzyme without water/reactants/contact does not supply T0. Cross-region powers require independence; no multicycle regeneration law follows.
